title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Section 3 Residue and IANA Registry Work Item
summary: Document the remaining RFC 9250 section 3 residue and section 8 registry governance, add the ALPN byte-sequence proof, and keep the verification slice stream/TLS-backed instead of adding any custom DoQ transport layer.
planned_changes:
- Update the RFC 9250 SPEC trace links for REQ-0001, REQ-0003, and REQ-0126 through REQ-0133.
- Add ARC-QUIC-RFC9250-0022 to document the stream/TLS mapping and IANA registry policy buckets.
- Add verification-oriented requirement-home assertions under `tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests/RequirementHomes/RFC9250/REQ-QUIC-RFC9250-0022.cs`.
- Add or update focused tests proving large DNS responses flow through the DoQ stream path, DoQ ALPN bytes stay `doq`, and registry unknown/reserved values normalize to `UnspecifiedError`.
- Do not add a custom DoQ datagram, PMTU, or flow-control layer.
- Do not change the shared transport semantics beyond the small `DoqDefaults.Alpn` alias needed for verification.
verification_plan: Run restore/build/test for the RFC 9250 DoQ test project, validate the SpecTrace JSON artifacts, and check diff hygiene once the trace links and proof tests are in place.
out_of_scope: A custom DoQ datagram or PMTU layer.
Transport-level TLS changes unrelated to the existing QUIC bridge.
Adding new registry values or changing IANA policy.
completion_notes: The shared QUIC transport already owns the stream and TLS behavior; this slice only closes the RFC 9250 section 3 residue and registry-governance trace and proof surfaces.
